changes.text: EgoExplorer: InternRobotics/EgoExplorer-100 (created 2026-11-04; 3,130 episodes, 104.8 h, 949 GB, tactile among the per-episode modalities, card license Apache-2.0) is up behind a manual Hugging Face gate; availability partial -> gated. The OXT export now holds 1,513 episodes (111 GB), and the zarr copy left the mini repository (now 7.35 GB).

TachinTactileGlove-Demo01: the Hugging Face repository returned HTTP 401 on two scans in a row and the Tachintech account no longer lists it; availability public -> unclear. The derived MIT-Media-Lab/tachin-vitra-precut-mano-v1 card still describes the 102 processed segment videos with pressure arrays.
ViTacPhys: the project page shows 'Code (Coming Soon)' and 'Dataset (Coming Soon)' with no link; code not_released -> announced.
Touch2Trace: accepted to CoRL 2026 (arXiv comment); the project website has disabled Code and Dataset buttons labelled 'not yet available'. Code not_released -> announced; project link added.
